prompt: Add or update tests so delegate_task's model override schema is covered. Do not change production behavior unless tests reveal a real bug. Run the focused delegate tests.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'schema_valid or model_override'

prompt: Ensure delegate_task accepts a per-call model string override that changes only the child model while preserving inherited provider credentials. Add a focused unit test if missing.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'model_string_override'

prompt: Ensure delegate_task accepts a per-call model object override with provider and model, resolving runtime provider credentials through the existing delegation credential resolver. Add a focused unit test if missing.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'model_object_override'

prompt: Ensure batch delegate_task supports per-task model overrides so one child can use a fast coding model and another can inherit defaults. Add or update a unit test that verifies AIAgent receives different kwargs per child.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'per_task_model'

prompt: Update the delegate_task model-facing description to say per-call model routing is supported and should be used only when explicit routing policy selects it. Keep the wording concise.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'schema_description'

prompt: Create a concise developer note under docs or evals explaining when to route subagents to GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark versus a frontier model. Include escalation rules. Do not touch unrelated docs.
verifiers: test -f evals/model-routing/spark-routing-policy.md

prompt: Add a lightweight validation path for the Spark routing eval pack so malformed JSONL entries fail fast before any live model run. Keep it stdlib-only.
verifiers: python scripts/model_routing_eval.py --pack evals/model-routing/spark_fast_code.jsonl --dry-run --limit 3

prompt: Make the model routing eval runner write JSONL result rows with case id, model, duration, verifier exit codes, and diff stats. Keep dry-run side-effect free.
verifiers: python scripts/model_routing_eval.py --pack evals/model-routing/spark_fast_code.jsonl --dry-run --limit 1 | grep -i 'dry run'

prompt: Update delegation config comments to mention that config-level delegation.model is the default but per-call model overrides can route individual child agents. Do not change defaults.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'model_only_no_provider'

prompt: Document the escalation rule: if Spark touches more than 8 files, fails verification twice, or changes security/data-model boundaries, reroute to GPT-5.5/Claude review. Keep it near the eval policy.
verifiers: grep -R "fails verification twice" evals/model-routing

prompt: Verify the registry handler forwards args['model'] into delegate_task. Add a focused unit test if missing.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'schema_valid or per_task_model'

prompt: Add coverage that invalid model override types return a user-friendly ValueError from credential resolution instead of crashing later.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'invalid_model_override'

prompt: Ensure model override objects can optionally carry base_url/api_mode for direct endpoint routing while reusing existing direct endpoint detection. Add a focused unit test if missing.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'direct_endpoint'

prompt: Check the new model routing test/runner output does not print API keys or secrets. If needed, redact result fields. Keep tests deterministic.
verifiers: python scripts/model_routing_eval.py --pack evals/model-routing/spark_fast_code.jsonl --dry-run --limit 2 | grep -vi 'api_key'

prompt: Ensure live model-routing evals run in isolated git worktrees or clearly document that they must. Avoid running live evals in the developer's dirty working tree.
verifiers: grep -R "worktree" scripts/model_routing_eval.py evals/model-routing

prompt: Add a timeout argument to the model routing eval runner so live Hermes calls cannot hang indefinitely. Default should be conservative.
verifiers: python scripts/model_routing_eval.py --help | grep -- --timeout

prompt: Add a repeatable --model provider:model argument to the eval runner. Dry-run should list the selected model routes without invoking Hermes.
verifiers: python scripts/model_routing_eval.py --dry-run --model openai-codex:gpt-5.3-codex-spark --limit 1 | grep 'gpt-5.3-codex-spark'

prompt: Make the eval runner print a compact summary table grouped by model after live runs. Dry-run may print planned runs only.
verifiers: python scripts/model_routing_eval.py --dry-run --limit 1 | grep -i 'planned'

prompt: Add the decision rule to the Spark routing policy: Spark wins only if quality is at least 90 percent of GPT-5.5 and end-to-end speed is at least 2x faster, otherwise keep it opt-in.
verifiers: grep -R "90\|2x" evals/model-routing/spark-routing-policy.md

prompt: Run the focused delegate_task tests after model-routing changes and fix any failures without expanding scope.
verifiers: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/tools/test_delegate.py -q -k 'model_override or per_task_model or schema_valid'
